questions.prompt: According to the State of Global Air 2025 report (IHME Global Burden of Disease estimates), how many deaths worldwide were attributable to air pollution in 2023?

source.name: Health Effects Institute / IHME (State of Global Air)

questions.insight: Of those 7.9 million deaths, 6.8 million (86%) were from noncommunicable diseases.

questions.prompt: What share of the world's total freshwater withdrawals is used by agriculture (irrigation, livestock and aquaculture), according to FAO AQUASTAT data for 2022?
questions.insight: Agriculture is by far the largest user of freshwater, ahead of industry and household supply.

questions.prompt: According to UNESCO, how many children, adolescents and youth of school age worldwide were out of school in 2024?
questions.insight: UNESCO says roughly one in six school-age children and youth are excluded from education, and the total has risen for seven consecutive years.

questions.prompt: What share of adults (aged 15+) worldwide had an account at a financial institution or with a mobile money provider in 2024, according to the World Bank's Global Findex?
questions.insight: That is up from 74% in 2021, yet about 1.3 billion adults still have no account.

questions.prompt: In 2024, what share of the world's population used safely managed sanitation services (a toilet whose waste is safely treated or disposed of)?
questions.insight: Since 2015, 1.2 billion more people gained safely managed sanitation, yet about 3.4 billion people still lack it.
